decision: NX-034 §2.1 (D1-D7 settled). The images of a stage release, built from a clean checkout of the released commit and saved with docker save into the release directory. Every image is named nexloop/<name> (the reference the NX-032 deploy dry-run renders: nexloop/<name>@sha256:<manifest digest>) and tagged with the release_id. Build arguments name base images in versions.lock.json and are passed by digest. 'build' images are built from a context prepared by the repository's own preparation scripts; 'upstream' images are pinned third-party images (already present by digest, never pulled by tag) retagged into the release. The web front end is built into the backend image. 'base' names the lock entry of the final stage (recorded as base_digest). 'tool_args' pass exact tool versions read from versions.lock.json (a missing value refuses the build); 'security_args' pass the exact Debian security updates of a base image (versions.lock.json images.<base>.security_updates, "package=version" pins; NX-036: fixed Critical findings the upstream base still carries); 'mirror_args' pass optional package mirror base URLs from the build host's environment (signature checks unchanged, deploy/postgres/Dockerfile). postgres (NX-035): the pinned PostgreSQL + pgvector image with pgBackRest, the DATA_HOST image of a release.
